headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Mindbody.

howItWorks.body: Mindbody's API returns a list of available slots with the details needed to book them. When a caller wants to schedule, the agent uses that information to book an appointment against a location, staff member, session type, and start time. Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity, and what the agent won't do.
howItWorks.title: Checks availability and books appointments

howItWorks.body: If a caller is not already in Mindbody, the agent can create a new client record there. After the call, it can follow up by text message. Everything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call.
howItWorks.title: Creates new client records

howItWorks.body: Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them. You keep Mindbody and everything else you already use.
howItWorks.title: Every call is logged and you stay in control

intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for salons and spas that run Mindbody. The agent answers calls when your team can't — after hours and when the line is busy — and works with Mindbody rather than replacing it.

The agent connects to Mindbody's API so it works from the same information your team sees. It can check available appointment slots, book appointments, and create new client records, within what Mindbody's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
